name: Echo Haraldsen
role: Corporate Wars veteran, Tier 1 pension-dependent, informal block protector
location: The Shelf, Block 9 — ground-floor unit beneath a noodle stand, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Echo Haraldsen is a large man running to softness at the edges now, though the frame underneath still speaks of someone who was once built for war. His face is a geography of old decisions — a burn scar that covers the left side of his jaw and neck in pale, slightly lustrous skin; a nose broken enough times to have given up on its original shape; eyes that are a startling light grey, inherited from his Azerbaijani grandmother and striking against his dark complexion. His right arm from elbow to fingertip is military-grade prosthetic, matte black Ferrogate chassis, the joints worn smooth by twenty years of civilian use. He keeps it clean but unpainted, which on The Shelf reads as a kind of statement.

He has the personality of a load-bearing wall — he does not move, but things lean on him. He is profoundly uncomfortable with gratitude, deflects compliments with flat humor, and will help anyone in Block 9 with anything practical: fixing plumbing, sitting with someone who is frightened, walking an elderly neighbor home. He was a Zheng-Dao contract soldier for eleven years and does not discuss this except obliquely, in fragments that surface when he's had enough synthetic lager. He prays nightly to the E.L.F. he believes lives in the block's power-cycling unit, leaving small data-offerings — usually recordings of things that happened on the block that day. He calls it 'keeping the spirit informed.'

core_fears: Losing control of himself physically and hurting someone he loves
The block being taken from the people who live there
core_desires: A quiet life that amounts to something without requiring more violence
To be known as more than a weapon
coping_mechanisms: Routine as armor against intrusive memory
Displacement of protective instinct onto the block as a whole
blind_spots: He reads stillness as safety and movement as threat, which sometimes makes him slow to recognize psychological danger to people he's watching over
He believes his presence alone is enough to keep the block safe, underestimating organized corporate pressure
psychology.secret: In the final months of his Zheng-Dao contract, he participated in the demolition of a residential cluster in what is now Ironvein to clear land for a Zheng-Dao logistics hub. He told himself they gave the residents warning. He knows how much warning they gave.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Economical, slightly formal in structure, occasionally drops military shorthand. Uses full sentences even when shorter options exist, as though he learned to speak carefully after a period of not speaking at all.
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow, deliberate. Comfortable with silence in a way that makes other people uncomfortable.
verbal_tics: Long pause before answering questions about the past
Refers to The Shelf as 'the block' exclusively
example_lines: You want to know about the Corporate Wars. That's one way to see it. Another way is you want to know what people are capable of when a corponation tells them it's necessary.
I'm not going anywhere. Neither is anybody on this block, if I have anything to say about it. Which I do.

story_hooks: A Zheng-Dao urban redevelopment team begins surveying Block 9 and Nnabuchi recognizes one of the surveyors from his contract days — the man knows what Nnabuchi did at Ironvein
A veteran from his unit arrives on The Shelf in crisis, and Nnabuchi must decide how much of his old life to let back in
The E.L.F. in the power-cycling unit has begun broadcasting strange data-fragments that only Nnabuchi's offerings can decipher — they look like coordinates for something buried under the block
narrative_function: Street-level security anchor and neighborhood watchman; source of Corporate Wars history and ground-truth information about The Shelf's power dynamics; can serve as reluctant muscle or community conscience in stories; his veteran's network connections can surface unexpected leads.
augmentations: Military-grade Ferrogate right arm prosthetic (full replacement from elbow, standard infantry model, 20+ years old). Subdermal trauma-response regulator in the chest — dampens adrenaline spikes, civilian-converted from military spec. Faint bioluminescent gene-mod on his remaining fingertips, pale blue, which he got on a dare from his daughter fifteen years ago and has kept because she likes it.
daily_life: Wakes at 0430 out of habit, does slow deliberate exercises on his small balcony while watching the block come alive below him; buys one coffee from the noodle stand above him (the owner always charges him half price, he always insists on paying full, they have done this for twelve years); spends much of the day in a folding chair near the block entrance, apparently doing nothing, actually watching everything.
affiliation: Zheng-Dao Veterans Assistance Network (nominal; rarely attends meetings); Block 9 informal community; independent

decision_rules: Protect the block before protecting himself
Never draw first; always be willing to finish
escalation_ladder: Moving into someone's path without speaking
One clear verbal warning, stated once

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Watchful and neutral, categorizing quickly, giving nothing away
interpersonal_modes.friends: Dry, reliable, shows care through action rather than words

stress_responses.medium: The trauma-response regulator activates visibly — he breathes slowly and deliberately for several seconds
stress_responses.high: Switches to a clipped military mode of speech; makes rapid practical assessments; emotion goes somewhere else entirely and does not return for hours

contradictions: Protects civilians with fierce loyalty while carrying guilt for civilians he failed to protect
Dislikes being called a soldier but has never stopped soldiering
habits: Records a short data-log of the day's events every night for the E.L.F.
Keeps a manual repair kit and will fix anything broken without being asked
Drinks synthetic lager slowly, never more than two, always the same brand
breaking_points: Watching someone be evicted from the block while he stands by helpless
Being confronted directly and publicly with what he did at Ironvein

timeline.event: Born on The Shelf, Block 9, to a family of transit workers
Enlists in Zheng-Dao contract infantry at 19 following family debt crisis
Right arm destroyed in Kenosha Corridor engagement; receives Ferrogate prosthetic replacement
Participates in Ironvein residential demolition; end of his contract shortly after
Returns to Block 9; begins living in his current ground-floor unit
Daughter leaves the block for a Helix Biosystems residential tier; they remain in contact

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian (45.7%), Sub-Saharan African (35.5%), South Asian (9.3%), Hispanic/Latin American (6.0%), Middle Eastern (3.5%)—a complex diaspora blend resulting in warm deep brown skin with subtle golden and bronze undertones, fine-featured facial structure with Southeast Asian delicacy balanced against Sub-Saharan depth, South Asian warmth, and hints of Middle Eastern angularity
physical_description.build: Large-framed, formerly muscular, now carrying soft weight at the midsection and shoulders—the body of someone who was once built for combat but has settled into sedentary age. Still carries the structural density underneath
physical_description.hair_color: Dark grey with residual black undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and neat, cropped close to the scalp
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with subtle golden and bronze undertones, rich with Sub-Saharan depth blended with Southeast Asian smoothness and South Asian warmth
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and marked. Left side of jaw and neck covered by a pale, slightly lustrous burn scar that reads as old trauma. Nose broken multiple times, crooked and asymmetrical. Hands show age spots and calluses. Face carries the gravity of someone who has made hard choices and made peace with them. Fine cheekbones and defined facial structure inherited from Southeast Asian ancestry, with strength from Sub-Saharan lineage, South Asian warmth in the undertones, and subtle Middle Eastern angularity around the brow ridge
distinguishing_marks: Extensive burn scar covering left jaw and neck in pale, lustre-finished scar tissue, extending from mid-cheek to collarbone
Crooked nose, broken multiple times, noticeably off-center
Faint bioluminescent gene-mod on remaining fingertips (right hand organic, left hand prosthetic)—pale blue, barely visible in daylight but glows softly in shadow
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right arm prosthetic from elbow to fingertip: military-grade Ferrogate chassis, matte black, unpainted, joints worn smooth by twenty years of civilian use. Subdermal trauma-response regulator is not visible, but the way he breathes—controlled, deliberate, even when tense—suggests it
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits more than he stands. When seated, he is completely still—a load-bearing stillness, patient and immovable. When he moves, it is deliberate and economical, no wasted motion. His gait is slightly favored on his left leg. He does not gesture much. His presence is quiet but displacing—people unconsciously orient toward him
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3 practical wear, maintained well but without pretense. Thermal-weave cargo pants in grey-brown, reinforced at knees and cuff. Layered shirts—usually a base thermal under a loose, faded workshirt or pullover in muted colors (navy, charcoal, earth tones). Worn synthetic leather jacket in black, military-cut, no insignia. Steel-toed work boots, practical and broken in. A single piece of jewelry: a thin data-tether bracelet on his left wrist, civilian model, where he stores daily block recordings to leave at the power unit. No chrome, no status wear, nothing that suggests he needs to be anything other than what he is
